name: LiveAgent
one_liner: Customer support helpdesk platform for tickets and agents, with an API v3 and built-in MCP server.
auth_notes: API v3 uses an apikey request header generated by an admin under Configuration > System > API. OAuth 2.1 is documented only for the MCP server, not the REST API.
access_notes: Admin generates the v3 API key under Configuration > System > API, which is self-serve. Pages mention a free trial account for testing but do not state which plans include API access or any cost.

buildability.rationale: Self-serve admin-generated API v3 key with a documented apikey header and in-account docs. Plan tier that includes API access is not stated on the pages.
